title: Always Check 6-digit HUID
tip: Since April 2023, BIS hallmark with a unique 6-digit alphanumeric HUID is mandatory across India. Verify it with the BIS Care App before paying.

title: Deduct Stone Weight
tip: Never pay gold rates for stone or enamel weight. Always demand the 'Net Gold Weight' bill, separated from the gross ornament weight.

title: Making Charges are Negotiable
tip: Most branded and local jewelers have a 15–30% negotiation buffer on making charges, especially during festival seasons (Diwali, Akshaya Tritiya).

title: 22K vs 24K Rate Check
tip: Ornaments are usually 22K (91.6% pure). Ensure the jeweler is calculating based on the 22K rate, not the higher 24K bullion rate.

title: Watch Out for 'Wastage' (Kadam)
tip: Some jewelers charge both 'Wastage %' and 'Making Charges'. For modern machine-made jewelry, wastage should be minimal or rolled into making charges.

title: Insist on Itemized GST Bill
tip: A legitimate invoice must clearly separate: Net Gold Value, Making Charges, and 3% GST. This is critical for future resale or exchange value.
